title: Sales & Marketing Executive
description:
**Key Job Responsibilities**

* Business Development: Identify and acquire new customers domestic and globally to achieve sales targets.
* Lead Generation: Generate business leads through field visits, cold calling, customer references, industry networks, exhibitions, and other marketing activities.
* Product Promotion: Promote plastic packaging products and understand customer requirements to offer suitable packaging solutions.
* Customer Relationship Management: Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers to ensure repeat business and long-term growth.
* Sales and Order Conversion: Prepare quotations, negotiate commercial terms within approved limits, follow up on enquiries, and convert prospects into confirmed orders.
* Market Research: Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing, and emerging customer requirements to identify new business opportunities.
* Order Coordination: Coordinate with Production, Quality, PPC, Dispatch, and Accounts to ensure timely order execution and customer satisfaction.
* Payment Follow-up: Coordinate with customers and the Accounts Department for timely collection of outstanding payments and adherence to approved credit terms.
* Sales Reporting: Maintain customer databases, field visit reports, sales forecasts, quotations, and periodic sales performance reports.
* Market Expansion: Conduct regular customer visits to expand the customer base and increase sales.

**Candidate Profile**

* Qualification: Graduate in Marketing, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related discipline; MBA in Marketing is an added advantage.
* Experience: Preferably 3–5 years in sales, field marketing, or business development. Experience in plastic packaging, flexible packaging, or manufacturing is preferred.
* Skills: Strong communication, negotiation, customer acquisition, and sales conversion skills.

title: Director, Product Management - Platforms
description:
**Description**
At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.
  
  
Gigamon is seeking a Director, Product Management for it's core platforms, to play a vital role in our product line management team focused on the software that runs on all of the hardware platforms. The person in this role will be working as part of a team in this domain, with the responsibility to drive, manage and enable product success from ‘vision’ to ‘bookings’. The right candidate will be a strategic team player with demonstrated excellence in understanding market and customer needs, collaborating with other stakeholders to develop product strategy and translate that strategy into world-class products.
  
  
The ideal candidate would have an excellent understanding of networking, competitive analysis and is obsessed with starting from the customer problems and working backward.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Product strategy: Define the vision and roadmap for the hardware and system software product, considering market trends, customer needs, and competitor analysis to identify potential features and functionalities.
* Product development and team work: Collaborate with engineering to develop, and implement new features, enhance existing ones, prioritize key fixes, and ensure the product meets performance and scalability requirements.
* Market analysis: Understanding the competitive landscape, market segments, and customer requirements to position the product effectively.
* Product launch: Plan and execute product launches with a cross functional set of stakeholders, including internal and external enablement.
* Voice of the customer: Meet regularly with customers and partners to evangelize the vision, strategy, and roadmap, and collect feedback both on existing products and features but also building an understanding of where customers are going next, with a focus on the "why".
* Technical expertise: Visibility platforms require a strong understanding of both hardware architectures and network protocols. Bringing a strong understanding of networking will be key to working well with both customers and engineering.

**What You'll Bring**

* At least 7+ years of Product Management experience.
* 20+ years overall experience.
* Previous experience working with operating systems, platforms, system architecture, or related technologies.
* Well rounded Product Management skills, from working with customers to understand pain points, translating these into well written requirements, articulating the needs both at a technical and business level.
* Prior experience driving requirements, from initial writing, to discussions with engineering, to delivery in a release.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience working cross-functionally, with Engineering, Project Management, Marketing, and Technical Marketing/Product Marketing.

**Who You Are**

* Demonstrated desire for continuous learning and improvement.
* Ability to manage and influence positively through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building.

As an equal opportunity employer, all applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, age, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, and/or local law. For more information, please refer to Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation for all qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at (669) 240-2248.
  
  
If your experience and skills closely match our job description but may not necessarily fulfill all requirements, please still apply. Gigamon is on a continued mission to grow and scale an innovative organization. We believe this is best achieved by hiring, celebrating, and respecting people with diverse backgrounds, skills, perspectives, and experiences.
  
  
The privacy rights of all individuals including job applicants and candidates are very important to us. Our Gigamon Applicant Privacy Policy, will inform you about how Gigamon Inc. and its direct and indirect subsidiaries collect, use, store, or otherwise process personal information about job applicants and candidates, including through your access and/or use of our careers website and third-party job websites (e.g. LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, Naukri, etc.).
  
  
We may use automated tools, including AI-based systems, to help screen and evaluate application materials for this role. These tools are designed to assess job-related qualifications only and do not make final hiring decisions; human reviewers remain involved in the process. Further, Gigamon uses Jobvite, developed by Employ, to screen and evaluate all Gigamon applicant resumes. The system analyzes resumes for skills, experience, and qualifications and processes employment history, education, and skills. This AI-based system is used for all Gigamon positions. For questions, contact [email protected]. You have the right to request reasonable accommodation; to do so, please send a message to [email protected].
